{{Quote|I was a pilot in the Ividal Sector Forces&mdash;Foxfire Squadron&mdash;when the Republic came calling.|Jorn Kulish|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The '''Ividal sector''' was a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Ividal system/Legends|Ividal]], [[Ongary system/Legends|Ongary]], [[Tomark system/Legends|Tomark]], and [[Uvadala system/Legends|Uvadala systems]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] captured the astronomical object [[Ongary IX]] and converted its [[hfredium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] into [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]] bases.

In response, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], whose [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] were tied up in an operation at the celestial body [[Uvadala]], recruited the [[Ividal Sector Forces]]' [[Foxfire Squadron]] to carry out a [[Attack on Ongary IX|series]] of [[bombing run]]s on the Ongary IX Separatist facilities. After one successful [[Bomber/Legends|bombing]] run, Foxfire Squadron's [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|starfighters]] were transported back to its base on the astronomical object [[Ividal]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a [[Chiron Base|starfighter base]] on the Ividal [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tomark II]].

==Description==
The Ividal [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Slice" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Sloo sector/Legends|Sloo sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[Hertae sector/Legends|Hertae sector]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], and the [[Sevastol sector/Legends|Sevastol sector]] [[spinward]]. It also formed a four-way border with the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba]], [[Doldur sector/Legends|Doldur]], and [[Haserian sector/Legends|Haserian sectors]] in the [[trailing]] direction.<ref name="Mid Rim" />

The westernmost section of the Ividal sector contained the [[Tomark system/Legends|Tomark system]], while the [[Uvadala system/Legends|Uvadala system]] lay in the sector's southernmost portion and the [[Ividal system/Legends|Ividal]] and [[Ongary system/Legends|Ongary systems]] were situated in its more northeastward parts.<ref name="Directions">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the Ividal [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] of [[Tomark system/Legends|Tomark]] in grid square Q-14, [[Uvadala system/Legends|Uvadala]] in square P-15, and [[Ividal system/Legends|Ividal]] as well as [[Ongary system/Legends|Ongary]] in square P-14, which, according to {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}, correspond to the westernmost, the southernmost, and the more northeastward sections of the sector, respectively.</ref> The Ividal and Uvadala [[Star system/Legends|systems]] contained the astronomical objects [[Ividal]] and [[Uvadala]], respectively. The Ongary system included the terrestrial celestial body [[Ongary IX]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> and the Tomark system contained the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tomark II]].<ref name="Journal11">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref>

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Back in the Clone Wars, the Seppies captured Ongary IX, looking for hfredium.|Jorn Kulish|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] were fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Foxfire Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] of the [[Ividal Sector Forces]], was stationed at Ividal. At some point during the conflict, the Confederacy became interested in Ongary IX's natural reserves of [[hfredium]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> a metal used in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] construction.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|39|hfredium}}</ref> Capturing the celestial body, the Separatists took over the hfredium [[Mining/Legends|mines]] and converted them into bases for their [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

[[File:StellarEnvoy-SWE.png|thumb|right|270px|The freighter ''Stellar Envoy'' visited the Ividal sector celestial body Ongary IX during the Clone Wars.]]
The Republic intended to [[Attack on Ongary IX|eliminate]] the Confederacy bases on Ongary IX but was unable to spare its starfighter squadrons, which at that time were engaged in a military operation at Uvadala. Instead, the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] recruited the Ividal Sector Forces, with Foxfire Squadron subsequently carrying out several [[bombing run]]s against Confederacy targets on Ongary IX.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

On the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] after a successful [[Bomber/Legends|bombing]] run that destroyed one of the Separatist bases, Foxfire Squadron's [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|starfighters]] were loaded aboard a Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] bound to return to the sector [[Planetary Security Forces|forces']] base at Ividal. Due to the experience of the Ongary IX attack, however, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jorn Kulish]] decided to leave the service, instead departing the celestial body as a passenger aboard the Coreward-bound<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]]<ref name="Millennium">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|Thank you for responding to my urgent summons. I apologize for disturbing your sleep, but a delicate situation has arisen. You are ordered to proceed directly to the ''Gambit'', my personal ship, without discussing this meeting with anyone. Board, take off, and plan a hyperspace jump using the coordinates in the nav computer to proceed to your destination.|Captain Amarith, to a group of Rebel agents|<ref name="Journal11" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Tomark II was the site of [[Chiron Base]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] facility housing a squadron of starfighters used for hit-and-run attacks on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoys]]. The world's [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] location made it ideal for staging such operations.<ref name="Journal11" />

The Empire eventually came to suspect Tomark of housing an [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] facility<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> and, by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' is presented as an [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|in-universe document]] which includes the report "[[IMQ-54544-XX-07 Security Clearance Black DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]" and was published nineteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which corresponds to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> it and several other worlds with unconfirmed potential Rebel presence were listed as priority targets for the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] in an [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] report entitled "[[IMQ-54544-XX-07 Security Clearance Black DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]."<ref name="IH" />

At some point during the Galactic Civil War, the Empire initiated on the<ref name="Journal11" /> [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]<ref name="EAOC Ando">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]]</ref> planet [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] a secret operation known as the [[Ando Project]]. In response, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Amarith]] of Chiron Base eventually dispatched a team of the Tomark II facility's resident agents on a [[Mission to Ando|mission]] in order to investigate the Imperial operation.<ref name="Journal11" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:StarWarsAdventureJournal11.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Ividal sector made its de facto first appearance in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 11.]]
The Ividal sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Journal11" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]," which placed it in grid squares P-14, P-15, Q-14, and Q-15.<ref name="Mid Rim" />

''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion placed the Tomark system, and therefore the world Tomark II, in the Ividal sector,<ref name="EAOC" /> thereby [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively establishing]] the world's original appearance in "[[The Ando Project]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure authored by [[Chris Doyle]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' and published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' in [[November]] [[1996]], as a de facto appearance of the sector, as well.<ref name="Journal11" />

In "The Ando Project," the player characters travel from Ando to an [[Aquaculture Facility|Imperial facility]] on the<ref name="Journal11" /> [[Yucrales sector/Legends|Yucrales sector]]<ref name="EAOC Uridia">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Uridia system/Legends|Uridia system]]</ref> [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uridia]]. If, after investigating the facility, the characters manage to escape it and leave the [[Uridia system/Legends|Uridia system]], they return to Chiron Base on Tomark II, where they submit their mission report.<ref name="Journal11" />
